sql_predicates: issues.state_id IN (SELECT workflow_states.id FROM workflow_states WHERE workflow_states.state_group NOT IN ('completed', 'cancelled') AND workflow_states.project_id = :project_id)

issues.priority_id IN (SELECT project_priorities.id FROM project_priorities WHERE (lower(project_priorities.slug) IN ('high', 'urgent') OR lower(project_priorities.label) IN ('high', 'urgent')) AND project_priorities.project_id = :project_id)
EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM issue_assignees WHERE issue_assignees.issue_id = issues.id AND issue_assignees.principal_id = :caller_principal_id)

EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM issue_labels WHERE issue_labels.issue_id = issues.id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_labels WHERE project_labels.id = issue_labels.label_id AND lower(project_labels.name) IN ('security')))
NOT (issues.cycle_id IN (SELECT cycles.id FROM cycles WHERE cycles.status = 'active' AND cycles.project_id = :project_id))
